changes: New: Bryan T's VIBRATO, a pitch vibrato with its depth in cents: sine, triangle, a two-note trill (SQR) or a random pitch every half cycle (RND).
Runs on FX1 or FX2 of any audio track. SPD and DEP glide, so a fast twist or an LFO stays smooth; SLEW rounds the shape, WID spreads it in stereo, MIX blends the dry track back in.
About three quarters of SPRING REV's DSP time, and nothing on the CPU.
Known: RND on the same slot of track 1 and track 5 draws the same random pattern.
